fixture_name: A9 Ballinluig SB signage/VRS-adjacent visibility — real UK Stage 1&2 RSA (Transport Scotland OGL release)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Stage 1 junction off-slip curve with reduced forward visibility and pedestrian passage is a substantive safety concern.
justifications.evidence_grounding: EV-UK-025 verbatim quote supports reduced visibility, pedestrian passage, and extended vegetation clearance.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Presented as a safety concern appropriate to DMRB Stage 1, not a compliance question.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation specifies delivering, evidencing, and verifying both visibility and pedestrian passage.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians are explicitly identified and their passage is central to the recommendation.

justifications.substance: Obscured view to slip-road terminus directly reduces slowing awareness at a speed transition, a substantive safety concern.
justifications.evidence_grounding: EV-UK-025 provides a verbatim quote supporting the pivotal view-and-awareness claim.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: The finding remains a safety concern and does not conflate compliance questions with safety issues.
justifications.recommendation_quality: The recommendation specifies a post-clearance drive-through at design speed and recording of the check.
justifications.vru_coverage: Vulnerable road users are explicitly considered and judged not exposed, so non-applicability is acknowledged.
